items.headline: Council reviews red light camera safety program
items.summary: The City Council received a presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program and considered authorizing continuation of the program, which uses cameras at intersections to enforce traffic signals.

items.headline: Council briefed on Milpitas Community Center's condition
items.summary: The City Council received a presentation on the physical condition of the Milpitas Community Center and discussed next steps for the facility.

items.headline: 5-unit townhouse project permitted on Seely Avenue
items.summary: A new 5-unit townhouse building at 0 Seely Avenue (Lot 21 of the Trimble Summerhill development) has received its building permit, valued at $1,841,161.

items.headline: ByteDance/TikTok office space cleared for $4M buildout
items.summary: A tenant improvement permit for $4,000,000 was issued for ByteDance/TikTok's office space on Floors 1 and 3 at 1143 Coleman Avenue #1.
